A pattern means the same category reached 7/10 in at least 4 complete cycles (60% or more of them) and at least 3× as often as outside these windows. A cycle window = 7 days before the period plus the period days, with at least 3 check-ins. Abdomen / lower back covers the classic areas; Joints = knee, ankle, hip, heel; Muscles = thigh, calf. A signal to read with the athlete, not a diagnosis.
